employees_manager_not_self_check.name: employees_manager_not_self_check
employees_manager_not_self_check.value: manager_id IS NULL OR manager_id <> id

leave_policy_rules_accrual_method_consis.name: leave_policy_rules_accrual_method_consistency_check
leave_policy_rules_accrual_method_consis.value:
(accrual_method <> 'MONTHLY' OR accrual_rate_per_month IS NOT NULL)
                AND
                (accrual_method <> 'ANNUAL_GRANT' OR annual_grant_amount IS NOT NULL)

leave_request_approvals_status_acted_at_.name: leave_request_approvals_status_acted_at_consistency_check
leave_request_approvals_status_acted_at_.value:
(status = 'PENDING' AND acted_at IS NULL)
                OR
                (status <> 'PENDING' AND acted_at IS NOT NULL)

leave_ledger_period_date_order_check.name: leave_ledger_period_date_order_check
leave_ledger_period_date_order_check.value:
(period_end IS NULL OR period_start IS NULL)
        OR
        (period_end >= period_start)
